actions.reason: Use two-character string keys for pair counts in RegexTokenizer.train instead of two-character tuples. The training representation already stores token ids as one character per id and uses str.replace for merges, so keeping adjacent pairs in the same representation avoids tuple pair allocation and lets the merge string be reused directly while preserving the same tie-breaking and merge outputs.
